name: mixer-djoon
description: MIXER DJooN — By BohlamSunarya. 24-channel Web Audio digital mixer for desktop and Android packaging.
author: BohlamSunarya

scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && electron-builder --win nsis portable
scripts.android:init: npm run build:web && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android-manifest.cjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android-manifest.cjs
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-android.cjs debug
scripts.apk:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-android.cjs release
